reason: I want to take the last greens before putting the equipment away; scissors seem suited to harvesting the nursery.
expectation: I expect to cut and collect lettuce from the nursery.

alternatives.reason: Securing the water line also serves the departure goal, but I want to harvest first.

effect: The nursery leaves are harvested; I can prepare them for taking.
reaction: As expected; a small satisfying harvest.
reason: Washing the leaves seems the next practical step before taking them.
expectation: I expect clean leaves ready to eat or pack.

effect: The departure greens are washed; I can turn to securing the station.
reason: The water line needs to be left safely stored, and the service tool may let me shut or drain it.
expectation: I expect the line to be secured for the unattended period, though I don't know the exact operation.

alternatives.reason: I also need to store the seed potatoes, but will handle the water line first.

effect: The water plant is winterized, so I can address the remaining equipment and seed stock.
reaction: The outcome fits the goal, though I would like to know what winterizing involved.
reason: The stored seed potatoes belong in the cool locker for the next season.
expectation: I expect the seed stock to be safely put into cool storage.

alternatives.reason: The clean trough also needs storing, but I chose the seeds first.

effect: The seed stock and greens goal is complete; the equipment still needs attention.
reaction: It is reassuring to leave seed for the next visitor.
reason: The clean refill trough is ready to put away on its equipment rack.
expectation: I expect the clean trough to be stored on the rack.

alternatives.reason: The lettuce trough also needs cleaning, but this trough is already clean.

effect: The clean refill trough is on the rack; the lettuce trough remains.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and water should rinse the used trough.
expectation: I expect a rinsed lettuce trough ready for further cleaning or storage.

effect: The lettuce trough is cleared and can now be stored.
reaction: The result makes sense, although it is another routine cleanup step.
reason: Putting the cleared trough on the rack is the only offered action and fulfills the storage goal.
expectation: I expect the equipment to be put away and the remaining goal to complete.

effect: The second trough is stored and the chapter goals are complete.
reaction: A quiet, practical conclusion, though the final placement itself is uneventful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Putting the seed potatoes in cool storage gave a concrete sense of leaving resources for the next surveyor.

leastWorthwhile.text: The consecutive trough cleanup and rack placements felt routine, with little detail or discovery.

surprise.text: The water-line action produced a winterized water plant in one step; I had expected a more specific operation and wanted to know what was done.

arbitrary.text: The actions generally had clear purposes; the exact operation behind winterizing was opaque.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue for the discovery in the ice and its return to Earth, though this chapter's cleanup alone offered few interesting decisions.
